sentences: Both a[0] and a[1] get their new values together, so the swap just works out.
I see a[0] becomes a[1] and a[1] becomes a[2] at the very same time.
Since everything changes together, the first two lines make a[0] six and a[1] seven.
The old five is gone before a[2] reads a[0], so a[2] should get six.
All three positions shift at once, so the array becomes six, seven, and five.
